The rationale has several claims that the card does not support, and the next steps are generic, so an investigator would need to redo some of the analysis.","problems":["Claims the excess 99215 share 'shows up in every complexity stratum', but the 0-condition stratum has 5.0% vs 2.2% (only 1 claim) and the 3-condition stratum is 15.9% vs 7.4%; the 'every stratum' claim rests on tiny cells and is not clearly stated as such.","Says the compressed mix 'favors upcoding', which is overly assertive. Having no 99211 or 99212 and most claims at 99214 is not by itself evidence of upcoding, and it contradicts the inconclusive leaning.","Cited example claims C0110564 and C0110609 are low-complexity 99215s, which is appropriate, but neither has documentation. They support the low-complexity point but not the documentation findings. The summary does not say these two have no records.","Next steps are generic ('larger sample', 'Re-screen') and do not name the specific claims. The rationale names the low-complexity claims, but the next_steps list does not carry them.","Confusing 'no cloning signal' line: '0 of 21 notes... had no lab line' is awkwardly phrased and 'no cloning signal' is an interpretive leap.","Describes C0110619 as documented at high MDM, which matches the card, but does not note that a depression patient with F32.9;R21 and no recorded minutes supporting 99215 is a possible concern; the summary also misses that C0110619 is listed under low-complexity and a repeat patient (M0046643) with C0110649."]}
